general.hebrew_fonts_info: Used for Hebrew text. Latin characters keep the fonts above.

heading.name: Heading
heading.text_info: Use italics to highlight words in the accent color.
heading.tag_info: Use one H1 per page for SEO.

mega_menu.name: Mega menu
mega_menu.menu_item_info: Title of a top-level item in the header menu, e.g. Jewelry. Its submenu becomes a full-width mega menu.

social_links.name: Social links
social_links.info: Manage links in Theme settings → Social media.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.info: Subscribers are added to Customers with the tag "newsletter".

variant_picker.name: Variant picker
variant_picker.show_swatches_info: Uses the color or image swatches set on the option's category metafield.

buy_buttons.name: Buy buttons
buy_buttons.show_dynamic_checkout_info: Shows the customer's preferred payment method, like Shop Pay or Apple Pay.
buy_buttons.show_gift_card_recipient_info: On gift card products, lets shoppers send the gift card to someone by email, on a date they choose.

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.content_info: Connect a product metafield to show different content for each product.

collection_tile.name: Collection tile
collection_tile.title_info: Leave empty to use the collection title.
collection_tile.caption: Caption
collection_tile.link_info: Leave empty to link to the collection.
collection_tile.image_info: Leave empty to use the collection image.
collection_tile.swatch_info: Shows a color or gradient instead of an image, e.g. for metals.

pickup_availability.name: Pickup availability
pickup_availability.info: Shows the local pickup locations set up in Settings > Locations.

size_guide.name: Size guide
size_guide.page_info: Adds the page's content to the size guide.
size_guide.only_sized_products: Only show on products with sizes
size_guide.only_sized_products_info: Shows the link only when the product has a "Size" option. Always shown in the theme editor.

sticky_add_to_cart.name: Sticky add to cart
sticky_add_to_cart.info: A bar with the add to cart button appears at the bottom of the screen once shoppers scroll past the Buy buttons block.

personalization.name: Personalization
personalization.engraving_note_info: Short note next to the option, for example "Free".
personalization.engraving_tag_info: Leave blank to offer engraving on every product.

inventory_status.name: Inventory status
inventory_status.threshold_info: Shows "Only X left" at or below this quantity. Needs inventory tracking.

product_specs.name: Product specs
product_specs.value_info: Connect a product metafield so each product shows its own value. Rows with no value are hidden.

back_in_stock.name: Back in stock request
back_in_stock.info: Shows an email form while the selected variant is sold out. Requests arrive as contact form emails with the product, variant and link.
back_in_stock.preview_in_editor: Always show in the theme editor

breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.fallback_collection_info: When shoppers didn't arrive from a collection.

bundle.name: Complete the set
bundle.info: Shows complementary products set up in the Search & Discovery app. Hidden when a product has none.

delivery_estimate.name: Delivery estimate
delivery_estimate.cutoff_hour_info: Orders after this hour count from the next business day. Uses the shopper's local time.

hero.name: Hero banner
hero.image_mobile_info: Optional. Shown on screens narrower than 750px.
hero.text_color_info: Buttons, tags and lists inside the banner adapt to this color.

header.transparent_on_home_info: Overlays the first section. Turns solid on hover and scroll.
header.transparent_logo_info: Optional light version of your logo.
header.layout_info: On mobile the logo is always centered.
header.show_country_info: Shown when you sell to more than one country. Manage countries in Settings > Markets.

footer.show_wordmark_info: Displays the store name in large type above the bottom bar.

product.name: Product information
product.enable_zoom_info: Opens images full screen, where shoppers can zoom in.

featured_collection.name: Featured products
featured_collection.link_info: Leave empty to link to the collection.

featured_product.name: Featured product
featured_product.product_info: Product to show in this section.

collection.name: Collection
collection.enable_filtering_info: Customize filters with the Shopify Search & Discovery app.
collection.promo_enabled_info: Shown in the product grid on the first page.

cart.show_additional_checkout_buttons_info: Such as Shop Pay or PayPal, when enabled in your payment settings.
cart.empty_collection_info: Shown when the cart is empty.

search.popular_searches_info: Separate terms with commas. Shown before a search and when nothing is found.
search.show_suggestions_info: Shown before a search and when nothing is found.

custom_liquid.name: Custom Liquid
custom_liquid.liquid_info: Add app snippets or other Liquid code to create advanced customizations.

product_recommendations.name: Product recommendations
product_recommendations.intent_info: Complementary products are set up per product in the Search & Discovery app. The section stays hidden when there's nothing to recommend.

slideshow.name: Slideshow
slideshow.autoplay_info: Pauses on hover and focus. Shoppers can also pause it, and it never auto-rotates for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

shop_the_look.name: Shop the look
shop_the_look.image_info: Add a hotspot for each product, then move it over the piece in the photo.

testimonials.name: Testimonials
testimonials.author: Author
testimonials.detail_info: For example "Verified buyer". Hidden when a product is selected.
testimonials.product_info: Links the testimonial to the product.

press_logos.name: Press logos
press_logos.image_info: Shown in grayscale. Use a transparent PNG or SVG.
press_logos.publication_info: Used as the image's alt text, or shown as text when there's no image.

marquee.name: Marquee
marquee.speed_info: Higher is slower. The marquee pauses on hover and stays still for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

video.name: Video
video.video_info: Uploaded videos take priority over a video link.
video.video_url_info: Loads only when shoppers press play.
video.background_mode_info: Uploaded videos only. Plays muted on a loop, with a pause button.

collage.name: Collage
collage.image_info: Optional for products and collections, which use their own image.
collage.title_info: Optional for products and collections, which use their own title.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.structured_data_info: Helps search engines show your questions in results. Use on one FAQ section per page.

countdown.name: Countdown
countdown.end_date_info: Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Uses your store's time zone.

newsletter_popup.name: Newsletter popup
newsletter_popup.frequency_info: Days to wait after a shopper closes the popup. Shoppers who subscribe won't see it again.

before_after.name: Before and after
before_after.after_image_info: Use two images of the same size and framing.

shoppable_gallery.name: Shoppable gallery
shoppable_gallery.product_info: Links the photo to the product and shows its name and price on hover. Uses the product image if no photo is set.
shoppable_gallery.link_info: Used when no product is selected, for example a link to the post.

stores.name: Store locations
stores.address_info: Also used for the "Get directions" map link.
stores.button_link_info: For example a booking page or your contact page.

comparison.name: Comparison table
comparison.value_info: Type "yes" or "no" to show a check or a cross.

product_cards.enable_quick_add_info: Single-option products are added straight to the cart; others open a quick view to choose options.
product_cards.new_badge_days_info: Days after a product is published. Set to 0 to turn off.
product_cards.custom_badges_info: Add custom badges with product tags that start with "badge:", for example badge:Bestseller. Up to two show per card.
product_cards.card_swatches_info: For a "Color" or "Metal" option. Hovering a swatch shows that variant's image.

cart.cart_type_info: The drawer opens from the header bag and after adding to cart.
cart.free_shipping_threshold_info: Order total for free shipping, in your store's currency. Set to 0 to hide the bar. It doesn't change your shipping rates.
cart.upsell_enable: Show product suggestions in cart drawer
cart.upsell_info: Based on Shopify's product recommendations for the first item in the cart.
cart.gift_wrap_product_info: Shows an "Add gift wrapping" checkbox in the cart that adds this product. Use a product with a single variant.
cart.show_discount_code_info: In the cart drawer and on the cart page.

colors.body_scheme_info: Used for the page background and text. Sections can pick their own scheme.
colors.background_gradient_info: Replaces the background color where sections use this scheme.

animations.reveal_on_scroll_info: Sections fade in as shoppers scroll. Turned off for shoppers who prefer reduced motion, and in the theme editor.
